text: 『硬派』
en: Hardcore

text: 初看这张图片，你是什么样的感觉呢？
en: When you first look at this picture, what sort of feeling do you have?

text: 一个肚腩硕大的男子裸着上身，穿着粉色的芭蕾舞裙在街头欢腾地跳跃。
en: A man with an enormous paunch, bare-chested, wearing a pink ballet skirt, leaps about joyfully in the street.

text: 令人受到强烈的视觉冲击！
en: It delivers a powerful visual shock!

text: 惊愕…
en: Astonished…

text: 嗤笑？
en: A scoff?

text: 反感…
en: Aversion…

text: 或者是厌恶？
en: Or perhaps revulsion?

text: 这般“粗犷”甚至有些“猥琐”的形象，怎么能和“硬派”连上线？
en: How could such a 'crude' and even somewhat 'sleazy' image be linked to 'hardcore'?

text: 允许我绕个圈，先从一部动画里的故事说起…
en: Allow me to take a roundabout route and begin with a story from an animated series…

text: 海贼迷们可能比较熟悉这个角色，而非海贼迷们其实也可以通过这个故事迅速代入。
en: One Piece fans may be fairly familiar with this character, yet even those who are not fans can quickly put themselves in his place through this story.

text: “塞尼奥尔.皮克”——臭名昭著的七武海（被政府认可的海贼）堂吉诃德麾下干部
en: Senor Pink — a notorious officer under Doflamingo of the Seven Warlords of the Sea (pirates sanctioned by the government)

text: 他丑陋！
en: He is ugly!

text: 猥琐！
en: Sleazy!

text: 粗鲁！
en: Crude!

text: 使用变态的、不合常理的招数！
en: He uses perverted, irrational moves!

text: 虽然我们的正派人物弗兰奇的招式也变态得防不胜防…
en: Although our protagonist Franky's techniques are also perverted enough to be impossible to guard against…

text: 可事实上却…
en: Yet in truth…

text: 身边美女如云
en: Surrounded by beautiful women

text: 却从来不感兴趣
en: Yet never the slightest interest

text: 明明有游泳果实能力（在任何地方都能够游泳）可以偷袭
en: Clearly possessing the Swim-Swim Fruit ability (able to swim anywhere), he could launch sneak attacks

text: 却永远只出现在敌人的正面
en: Yet he only ever appears head-on before the enemy

text: 护队友，不惜被打伤
en: Protects his comrades, unafraid to be beaten

text: 关心老太太
en: Cares for elderly ladies

text: 爱护小动物，连猫都…
en: Loves small animals, even cats…

text: 感动得…
en: Moved to…

text: 流下泪水…
en: Tears stream down…

text: 赛尼奥尔.皮克是海贼王中塑造得非常成功的角色之一，虽然表现夸张、搞笑，但以下这一段绝对够让你严肃起来…
en: Senor Pink is one of the most successfully portrayed characters in One Piece; though his behaviour is exaggerated and comical, the following scene will absolutely make you solemn…

text: 曾经…
en: Once…

text: 塞尼奥尔.皮克也是一名帅气、有男人味的绅士
en: Senor Pink was also a handsome, manly gentleman

text: 和女孩儿露西安在雨中相遇、相识
en: He met and came to know a girl named Lucian in the rain

text: 相恋、结婚
en: They fell in love and married

text: 有了可爱的儿子吉姆雷特
en: and had a lovely son, Gimlet

text: 然而天有不测风云，两人的孩子在一次高烧中不治身亡。
en: Yet fortunes are fickle; their child died from an untreatable high fever.

text: 而在此期间，露西安无论如何都联系不到在外执行任务（海贼帮派间的烧杀抢掠）的塞尼奥尔。
en: During this time, Lucian could not reach Senor Pink no matter what, as he was away on a mission (the arson, killing, looting and plundering between pirate gangs).

text: 事实的真相是：露西安最讨厌的就是海贼，而塞尼奥尔为和露西安在一起，隐藏自己海贼的身份，以银行职员自居。
en: The truth is: Lucian hated pirates most of all, and to be with her, Senor Pink concealed his identity as a pirate and presented himself as a bank clerk.

text: 一句很戳内心的攻击
en: A remark that pierces the heart

text: 知道真相的露西安愤然出走，却遇上暴风雨，在塌方中砸中脑袋变成植物人，从此不会再哭、不会再笑，不会再有任何的表情…
en: Upon learning the truth, Lucian left in a rage, but encountered a storm; a landslide struck her on the head and left her in a vegetative state, and from then on she could no longer cry, laugh, or show any expression whatsoever…

text: 痛失儿子，妻子又变成了植物人，赛尼奥尔痛心疾首。
en: Having lost his son and with his wife now in a vegetative state, Senor Pink was overwhelmed with grief and remorse.

text: 第一痛悔的是自己毁了露西安、毁了这个家庭…
en: His foremost regret was that he had destroyed Lucian and destroyed this family…

text: 从此以后，他每天带花到医院探望妻子，无论春夏秋冬、严寒酷暑。
en: From then on, he brought flowers to the hospital to visit his wife every day, regardless of spring, summer, autumn or winter, of bitter cold or sweltering heat.

text: 他是多么想…
en: How he longed…

text: 再一次见到妻子的笑容…
en: To see his wife's smile once more…

text: 偶然的一次机会，他发现：穿上吉姆雷特的婴儿帽，竟然让夫人露出了笑容！
en: By chance, he discovered that putting on Gimlet's baby bonnet actually made his wife smile!

text: 发现这个方法以后，他欣喜若狂，从此脱下西装…
en: Overjoyed at this discovery, he took off his suit from then on…

text: 被非议、被嘲笑…
en: Subject to criticism and mockery…

text: 即便在最伤感的时刻…
en: Even in the most sorrowful moments…

text: 你的笑也能瞬间把我治愈…
en: Your smile can heal me in an instant…

text: 我的爱人啊…
en: My beloved…

text: 所以对我来说…
en: So to me…

text: 在战斗中与弗兰奇拳拳对刚，丝毫不退缩，最终失去意识倒地，光荣战败。
en: In battle he met Franky fist to fist without the slightest flinch, and finally lost consciousness and fell, defeated honourably.

text: 而淌出的泪水则诉说着动人的故事…
en: And the tears that flowed told a touching story…

text: 纵然挺着肥硕的肚腩、戴着婴儿的帽子、穿着花色的尿布、又被揍得稀烂，却不负“男人”这一称号。
en: Even with his bulging paunch, a baby's hat on his head, colourful nappies on, and beaten to a pulp, he lived up to the title of 'man'.

text: 美国亚利桑那州男子凯里就好像是赛尼奥尔皮克的原型，妻子琳达罹患乳腺癌。
en: An Arizona man from America named Carey seems to be the prototype for Senor Pink; his wife Linda was stricken with breast cancer.

text: 为了逗妻子开心，他就开始穿上粉色芭蕾裙前往各地拍照。
en: To amuse his wife, he began putting on a pink ballet skirt and travelling to various places to take photographs.

text: 照片让夫妻俩在癌症治疗期间一直保持积极乐观的心态。
en: The photographs kept the couple in a positive and optimistic frame of mind throughout the cancer treatment.

text: 以上，就是男人真实的一面：硬派！
en: The above is the true side of men: hardcore!

text: 真心喜欢的女孩子，几乎都追不到，因为真心喜欢，做不到对她用套路，也不会费尽心思去取巧，就是单纯的喜欢，傻傻的喜欢，因为爱，心存敬畏。
en: The girls we genuinely like, we almost never manage to win over, because genuinely liking someone means we cannot play tricks on her, nor rack our brains to take shortcuts; it is simply liking her, foolishly liking her, and out of love we hold her in awe.

text: 好多人问爱是不是克制，我觉得克制显得没有爱那种韵味，我觉得爱，更多的是尊重，尊重对方，尊重自己，不欺骗，不隐瞒，不伪善，不逃避。
en: Many people ask whether love is restraint. I feel restraint lacks the flavour of love; I think love is more about respect — respecting the other, respecting oneself, not deceiving, not concealing, not being hypocritical, not evading.

text: 当男人身边或者网上出现觉得有可取地方的女孩子，比如说可以约炮？
en: When a girl who seems to have some merits appears by a man's side or online — for instance, someone he could have a casual hook-up with?

text: 或者是其他，换句话说，浪子就是猎人。
en: Or something else; in other words, a libertine is a hunter.

text: 而有的女孩子不经意出现就像猎物一样，当猎人发现猎物，男人就要开始布置陷阱，然后想办法靠近她，并伪装自己，在意犹未尽之前，男人说话客气，行事小心，给她做饭，给她洗衣服，买礼物，陪她看电影，带她出去玩，给她亲密的问候，可是事实上只想和她啪啪啪，啪完之后，就想歇着或者做自己的事情。
en: And some girls appear inadvertently like prey; when the hunter spots his prey, the man begins to lay traps, then finds ways to get close to her and disguise himself. Before he has had his fill, the man speaks politely and acts cautiously, cooks for her, washes her clothes, buys gifts, accompanies her to films, takes her out, gives her intimate greetings — yet in truth he only wants to shag her; once done, he just wants to rest or get on with his own affairs.

text: 但是出于礼貌，都会抱着她，陪他，像暖男！
en: But out of politeness, he will hold her and keep her company, like a warm man!

text: 不要觉得男人对你好就是爱你，渣男的特质就是对人好，表面蜜糖，实则砒霜。
en: Do not think a man treating you well means he loves you; the trait of a scumbag is precisely treating people well — honey on the surface, but arsenic in truth.

text: 但是呢，男人爱一个人是绝对会对她好，但是这种好的出发点和持续性完全不一样。
en: However, when a man loves someone, he will absolutely treat her well, but the starting point and the constancy of this kindness are utterly different.

text: 所以很多女孩子，分手后，总是感叹，为什么当初他那么爱我，包容我，现在却说变就变，或许你不愿意承认，他其实根本不爱你，他只是伪装他爱你，你以为你和他一拍即合，他懂你的小心思，他也容忍你的小脾气，其实真实的他，只觉得你就是个没有公主命，一身公主病的傻姑娘。
en: So many girls, after a breakup, always sigh over why he loved and indulged them so much at first, yet now changes at the drop of a hat. Perhaps you are unwilling to admit it, but he never truly loved you; he merely pretended to love you. You thought you and he were perfectly in tune, that he understood your little thoughts and tolerated your little tempers — yet the real him only thought of you as a silly girl with no princess destiny but a whole host of princess syndrome.

text: 造成这种原因，或许因为近年来，网络风气不正，在恋爱中越来越强调男人要有趣，男人要懂这懂那，要这样要那样，而这些花儿胡哨的东西，是可以学习的，是可以共同培养的，而我们却忽略了最廉价，又最宝贵的真心。
en: The cause of this may be that in recent years the online atmosphere has been unhealthy; in romance there is ever more emphasis on men being interesting, on men understanding this and that, on demanding this and that. Yet these flashy things can be learned and cultivated together, while we have neglected the sincerest heart, which is at once the cheapest and the most precious.

text: 世人还赞颂真心吗？
en: Do people still praise the sincere heart?

text: 有趣和颜值已是主流了吗？
en: Have being interesting and good looks become the mainstream?

text: 在我看来一段长久良好的关系，还是得靠责任和习惯，在生活上，工作上，兴趣上都合得来，彼此成为对方习惯中不可或缺的一部分，而责任，可以让两个人在道德上克己复礼，相互信任，与扶持，而爱这种东西，偶尔有就行了，要想和梦里一样长远持久，太难了。
en: In my view, a lasting and sound relationship still depends on responsibility and habit — getting along in life, work and interests, and becoming an indispensable part of each other's routines. Responsibility allows two people to restrain themselves and uphold what is proper, to trust and support one another. As for love, the occasional bit will do; to make it as enduring and lasting as in a dream is too difficult.

text: 也不知道为什么会这样，仿佛恶性循环，得不到自己想得到的，就迷失在森林里，因为迷失，又得不到自己想要的。
en: I do not know why it is like this, as if a vicious cycle: failing to obtain what one wants, one becomes lost in the forest; because of being lost, one again fails to obtain what one wants.

text: 以上，只是部分男人的个例，没有一棒子打死的说法，我之所以把这些负面消极的东西都说出来，也是希望自己能够迷途知返，也给诸位知友一点警醒。
en: The above is only the individual case of some men; it is not a sweeping condemnation. The reason I lay out all these negative and passive things is also in the hope that I myself can return from the wrong path, and offer you fellow Zhihu users a little warning.

text: 当然除了，这些不堪的…
en: Of course, aside from these sordid things…

text: 男人也有很多不为人知的好~
en: Men also have much unknown goodness~

text: 有的男人表面好面子，其实为了心爱的人，可以受很多委屈，他们带你去吃好吃的，玩好玩的，花钱从不小气，自己单独时，也会很节省，并且努力去赚钱。
en: Some men care about face on the surface, yet for the one they love they can endure much grievance. They take you to eat good food and do fun things, never stingy with money, yet when alone they are frugal and strive to earn.

text: 他们不懂女孩子的性格，心思，看上去愚笨木讷，但是也会花功夫，去思考，去牢记你们说过的话，与指导。
en: They do not understand girls' characters or thoughts, and seem dull and slow-witted, yet they will take the effort to think and to remember what you have said, and your counsel.

text: 他们或许不浪漫，不懂风情，但是在你睡着时，会帮你盖好被子，在你不开心时，会着急的像小猴子。
en: They may not be romantic or attuned to romance, but when you are asleep they will tuck you in, and when you are unhappy they will fret like a little monkey.

text: 所以啊，世界依然是美好的，不美好的只是一些误入歧途的人，与一些不负责任的事。
en: So you see, the world remains beautiful; what is not beautiful is only some who have strayed from the right path, and some irresponsible deeds.

text: 浪子回头金不换，值得歌颂的不是这个回头的浪子，而是这个浪子弥足珍贵的回头，希望看到这里的男人不要变成浪子，也希望是浪子的你，能够早日回头，而那些可爱的，善良的仙女们，祝你们永远不会遭遇浪子。
en: A repentant libertine is worth more than gold. What deserves praise is not the libertine who turns back, but that libertine's most precious turning back. I hope the men reading this will not become libertines, and I hope those of you who are libertines can turn back soon; and to those lovely, kind fairies, I wish you will never encounter a libertine.

text: love&peace
en: love&peace

text: 我知道很多人对此嗤之以鼻，但是我并不是想要为某种行为开脱，我只是单纯的最真实的与大家分享男人真实的一面，是的丑恶，肮脏，虚伪，然而真相如此。
en: I know many people sniff at this, but I do not mean to excuse any behaviour; I simply share, in the most honest and truthful way, the real side of men — yes, the ugly, the filthy, the hypocritical — yet such is the truth.

text: 祝好。
en: Best wishes.

text: 致谢所有浏览的“迷人家伙”！
en: Thanks to all the 'charming fellows' who browsed!
